items.label: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Warlock
items.versionNote: 2024 revised rules; level-5 prepared-spell count, Pact Magic slots, Magical Cunning, and replacement rule.

appliesTo.quote: At Warlock level 5, the 2024 table gives you **six base prepared-spell entries** and **two Pact Magic slots**, each of **3rd level**.
A 2024 Warlock can use Magical Cunning as a one-minute ritual to recover up to half the maximum number of Pact Magic slots, rounded up, then cannot use it again until a long rest.
When you gain a Warlock level, the 2024 class rule permits replacing one spell on your list with another Warlock spell for which you have spell slots.

items.label: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2014): Warlock
items.versionNote: 2014 class terminology is used only for the Spells Known comparison.

appliesTo.quote: The 2014 Warlock rules use **Spells Known**: the class gives you a limited list, and gaining a Warlock level lets you replace one known spell with another eligible Warlock spell.

items.label: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Spellcasting
items.versionNote: 2024 preparation, slot use, and one-spell-slot-per-turn rules.

appliesTo.quote: Use the [2024 spellcasting rules](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/spells) as the second check: preparing a spell does not spend a slot, while casting a spell with a slot does.
2024 also limits a turn to one spell cast with a spell slot. This is narrower and more precise than saying “only one spell per turn.”
Under the [2024 concentration rules](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Concentration), beginning another concentration spell ends your current concentration immediately.
Taking damage can force a Constitution saving throw: use the higher of DC 10 or half the damage rounded down, with a maximum DC of 30.

items.label: D&D Beyond: Eldritch Blast
items.versionNote: 2024 cantrip entry for action, range, beam, and damage fields.

appliesTo.quote: In the 2024 text it is a cantrip with a 1-action casting time and 120-foot range; each beam is a separate ranged spell attack that deals 1d10 force damage on a hit.
At character levels 5, 11, and 17, the spell produces two, three, and four beams respectively.

items.label: D&D Beyond: Misty Step
items.versionNote: 2024 spell entry for bonus action, visible unoccupied destination, range, and upcast fields.

appliesTo.quote: A bonus-action teleport for yourself to a visible, unoccupied space within 30 feet.
The 2024 text lists no upcast improvement. It is still a visible, unoccupied-space teleport of up to 30 feet.

items.label: D&D Beyond: Counterspell
items.versionNote: 2024 spell entry for reaction trigger, range, components, Constitution save, and slot outcome.

appliesTo.quote: A reaction when you see a creature within 60 feet casting a spell with verbal, somatic, or material components; that creature makes a Constitution save.
If the countered spell's caster fails the save and that spell used a slot, the caster does not expend that slot.

items.label: D&D Beyond: Dispel Magic
items.versionNote: 2024 spell entry for ongoing-spell timing, range, and higher-level check conditions.

appliesTo.quote: An action at 120 feet that ends an ongoing spell of 3rd level or lower automatically; higher-level spells require a spellcasting-ability check.
This is an answer to an effect already in place, not a reaction to the instant another creature begins casting.

items.label: D&D Beyond: Hypnotic Pattern
items.versionNote: 2024 spell entry for area, saving throw, conditions, and concentration limits.

appliesTo.quote: A 30-foot cube within 120 feet; creatures that see the pattern make Wisdom saves, and failures become Charmed, Incapacitated, and Speed 0.
It requires concentration, affects every eligible creature in the area, and damage or another creature using an action to wake a target ends that target’s effect.

items.label: D&D Beyond: Hex
items.versionNote: 2024 spell entry for bonus action, range, concentration, ability-check condition, and upcast duration.

appliesTo.quote: A bonus-action, 90-foot, concentration spell. Hits against the chosen creature deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and one chosen ability’s checks have disadvantage.
The disadvantage is on ability checks, not saving throws. It competes for concentration and its transfer after the target reaches 0 hit points still costs a later bonus action.
Its maximum concentration duration becomes 8 hours; the extra damage remains 1d6 per qualifying hit.

items.label: D&D Beyond: Invisibility
items.versionNote: 2024 spell entry for concentration, attack/spell termination, and additional-target upcast field.

appliesTo.quote: A touch spell that requires concentration; in the 2024 text, the target’s attack roll, damage, or spellcasting ends the spell early.
The “one extra target per slot level above 2nd” rule adds one target, so the 3rd-level cast can affect two targets total.

items.label: D&D Beyond: Fly
items.versionNote: 2024 spell entry for flying speed, hover, concentration, and target-count upcast fields.

appliesTo.quote: A touch spell that grants a willing target a 60-foot flying speed and hover while concentration lasts.
It remains one target; extra targets begin above 3rd level. The 60-foot flying speed and concentration requirement still govern the choice.
